## ScrollArea.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `orientation` :: Which axes can scroll.
- `maxHeight` :: Caps the height of the region: a ladder word (`lg`) or any CSS length (`24rem`).
- `scrollbar` :: When the scrollbar is shown: always when there is overflow, on hover and focus, or never.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the region. The region is keyboard-focusable so it can be scrolled from the keyboard.
- `children` :: The scrollable content.

## scroll-area.ts

### `function attachFades`

Writes edge-fade custom properties from the element's current scroll position.
